name: Pionery Zari
source: Five space mercenaries, led by Dmitry Gangarin, have completed a dangerous mission: they’ve secured a mysterious Artifact and are now on their way to sell it. The only question is — who will pay the highest price for their treasure… and what price will the mercenaries themselves have to pay before their journey is over?
